svg.title: PC-12 CONTROL YOKE - DETAIL
svg.desc: PC12-L6Y rev A, AS SHOWN, A1. RECONSTRUCTION FROM PUBLISHED DATA - NOT FOR CONSTRUCTION.

g.text: RECONSTRUCTION FROM PUBLISHED DATA - NOT FOR CONSTRUCTION
LOOKING FORWARD, AS THE PILOT SEES IT (CO-PILOT YOKE = MIRROR IMAGE) - SCALE 1:1
FROM OUTBOARD, NOSE LEFT, NEUTRAL PITCH; a 0 = X 3700 - 1:1
MID-PAD, NORMAL TO THE GRIP AXIS - 2:1
h 48 (BADGE / TCS), OUTBOARD HALF (THE INBOARD HALF MIRRORS IT WITHOUT THE TCS) - 1:1
ON THE WHITE ARM, u 58.5 h 51.4, <= 1 PROUD - 3:1
ON THE OUTBOARD HEAD'S FACET (38° UP) - 2:1
PLAIN FIELD (NO LETTERING); 3 SPEED-LINE GROOVES EACH WING, PITCH 1.3
ABSTRACT WINGED PLATE, TOP AT h 53.2 - 3:1
inboard of CL: top h +12, joint -24, screw -44;
NO BELLOWS; depth / fixed or moving: OPEN
AT THE LOWER PANEL, FROM OUTBOARD - 1:2
gloss clear-coat white, neutral-cool (0.77 / 0.78 / 0.80), fine pearl; R 1 edges [M]
satin aluminium 0.62, metallic 0.85, rough 0.30; badge grooves 0.5 [M]
smoke silver 0.30, metallic 0.85, rough 0.34; 0.47 x item 2 [M]
satin black, rough 0.42 (was 0.62): crisp edge highlights [M]
satin black, R 5 aft / R 11 forward edges [M / E]
charcoal 0.05, rough 0.58, 1.1 pebble grain, ~1 creases, bead [M]
gloss black bezel <= 1 proud, satin button recessed [M]
satin black ring + rocker, tick legends white 0.80 [M]
satin black dished collar, smooth cap, centre dimple [M]
satin dark grey moulding, J band 23 wide [M]
arm tips / stem at h 0 / at h -50
insert crown above the arm junctions
section A-A / rake / toe-out out, in
AFCS cap centre / dia x high
KNEES vs YOKE (L6B), REV H > REV I - CRITERIA UNCHANGED
Yoke-local mm: u outboard (pilot: -y), h up from the hub centre = the column axis / roll pivot (WL 1845, BL -/+375), a aft of the aft face at the insert step (X 3700 at neutral pitch). Drawn from
model/interior.py YOKE_DESIGN rev I; L6 / L6B take the same outline (yoke_outline_yz, yoke_sweep_pieces).
Symmetric moulding except the switches: TCS, AFCS DISC and the trim on the OUTBOARD side, the push button on the inboard head; the co-pilot yoke is the mirror image.
Sources: P1046408 through the fitted camera panel_408; P1046409 / 10, the Mexico and AOPA press photos, the JTF p.18 elevation; a bundle adjustment of 4 photos for depth. All photos look from
inboard: the outboard and the mirrored inboard traces are averaged; the drawn yoke, projected through the cameras, sits on the photos within 0.3-4.7 mm at the landmarks (overlays, refs/cache).
NO MARKINGS: the badge is an abstract winged plate, every legend a row of ticks.
Not modelled / unsupported: the rev H column bellows (none in 8 photos), a PTT trigger (none seen), the PC-24's extra button and grip tab.

Knee checks on the rev I outline: the 95th clears the yoke by 35 mm wings level (criterion 25: passes); roll to contact 17.5°, keeping 25 mm to 2.5° (rev H 5.0°) -- owner decision (open point 1 of L6B;
Absolute fore-aft station: the locked photos put the aft face 60 +/-30 forward of the drawn neutral (hub_dx kept: the gust-lock pose?).
Column: the surround's joint line reads WL 1821 +/-10 (25 under the pivot, kept); fixed J surround on the panel vs a curved arm moving with the yoke; push travel 90 [E] leaves 17 to the panel.
Toe-out 13 / 28 measured per grip (+/-8): symmetric 20 / 20 would suit a symmetric moulding but left the outboard pad too narrow in P1046410.
Hidden: body depth 60, top and foot radius, grip forward corners R 11, rocker / cap heights (+/-2).
PTT: none on the PRO in any photo; the PC-24 has a grip tab.
PHOTO CHECK: THE DRAWN YOKE THROUGH THE PHOTO CAMERAS (mm)
shell 1.8, insert 1.0, badge 1.1, rim 1.8, grips 4.1, slot 4.2; neck out 2.4 / in 14 *, inboard pad 6.6 *
shell 2.4, insert 1.6, badge 2.0, rim 1.7, grips 3.2, slot 4.1; neck out 2.5 / in 14 *, inboard pad 6.2 *

Only the yoke's photo pose (pitch, roll, a few mm of shift) is fitted per photo, to the landmark picks (TCS, AFCS cap, trim ring, button, badge, step ends, lower insert, foot); overlays in refs/cache/overlays/yoke
(private). * traced 'as seen' from inboard: features off the trace's 4.3° plane shift toward the camera (the inboard neck and the 28° toed inboard pad); the drawing follows the 3-D fit
first issue (owner 2026-10-05: 'the yoke isn't quite right especially if you look at the details'): yoke re-measured on 8 PRO photos (P1046408 through the fitted camera panel_408,
P1046409 / 10, Mexico and AOPA press photos, JTF p.18) incl. a bundle adjustment for depth; YOKE_DESIGN rev I replaces the rev H outline (L6 / L6B rev I)
